description: Data pack enchantments on digging and shooting (#315): a player starts to break stone with a Prospect pickaxe, so its hit_block effects run (ServerPlayerGameMode.handleBlockBreakAction): a match_block requirement, the rotated, randomized_int, noise_threshold, noise, dual_noise and copy_properties block state providers and the height_range, matching_biomes and any_of block predicates of replace_block. Then the player shoots a Spark bow, whose projectile_spawned effects with requirements (an entity type tag, another entity type, the weather) run on the arrow. Last the player loads and shoots a crossbow with Herd: its ammo_use effects with table_bonus and match_tool requirements in the item context of the arrow keep the arrows.

actions.command: item replace entity steve weapon.mainhand with minecraft:iron_pickaxe[minecraft:enchantments={"vanillite_test:prospect":1}]
item replace entity steve weapon.mainhand with minecraft:bow[minecraft:enchantments={"vanillite_test:spark":1}]
item replace entity steve weapon.mainhand with minecraft:crossbow[minecraft:enchantments={"vanillite_test:herd":1}]
